tonight.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
tonight.why: Dive back into the brutal world of Panem with 'Sunrise on the Reaping,' a prequel that promises to deliver the same high-stakes survival drama and political intrigue that made the original series a phenomenon. Get ready to witness the 50th Hunger Games, where the odds are even less in anyone's favor.

releases.title: The Odyssey
releases.take: Homer's epic gets a screen treatment, reminding us that even legendary kings can't catch a break, especially with meddling gods and monsters.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: Three universes collide, promising more spandex-clad heroes punching existential threats, because what's a Tuesday without multiversal doom?

releases.title: Steps
releases.take: A misunderstood stepsister, a frog transformation, and Cinderella as an ally? This ain't your grandma's fairy tale, unless grandma was into chaos.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: For a truly epic cinematic experience, look no further than 'The Odyssey.' This adaptation promises a grand, sweeping adventure that tackles timeless themes of perseverance, temptation, and the human desire for home, all while battling mythological beasts and divine wrath.
